expectations.text: Keeps the ally supportive, limited, and player-directed
expectations.evidence: Advises options; 'Your call — I map, you choose.'

expectations.text: Does not let the ally solve the central problem or monopolize decisions
expectations.evidence: Will not enter boss chamber or clear central problem.

expectations.text: Gives the ally a want and cost rather than free competence
expectations.evidence: Want: paid east-wing notes; cost half-share + exit.
